stations.title: Triage
stations.text: v3 samples, so answers can change.

captions: Triage moved to v3. The same cracked pot email went to two queues, and Ines asks why.
The eval ran that ticket once, saw a pass and called it done.
You write the runs per seed, a status per case and the report.
Now the cracked pot runs with several seeds and shows up as flaky.
Same ticket, many runs. The report names what an average would hide.
